G.1.label: Disclosed
G.1.rationale: Board of Directors has ultimate responsibility for climate oversight; Audit and Risk Committee oversees climate risk and TCFD disclosures and receives quarterly reports incl. climate exposure; FOPC reviews fossil-fuel projects; BAAC covers resources (PDF p.9).

G.2.label: Disclosed
G.2.rationale: Table 1 lists management committees with chairs, climate remit and meeting frequency (fortnightly); three-lines-of-defence model; CRO accountable for climate risk; dedicated Climate Risk team (pp.9-11); climate remuneration section 2.2.3 (p.12).

S.1.label: Disclosed
S.1.rationale: Time horizons defined (short <1y, medium 1-7y, long >7y); Table 2 maps strategic priorities to horizons; three types of climate opportunity described (pp.15-17); regional transition/physical risks (sec 4.3).

S.2.label: Disclosed
S.2.rationale: BORDERLINE (could be Partial): impacts on strategy/balance sheet described qualitatively in Table 2 (shift to lower-emitting sectors, GET finance share); resourcing via Strategy Implementation Plan; sec 3.4 says no material change to strategy/financial stability expected; financial effects quantified only via stress-test NPLs (p.44).

S.3.label: Disclosed
S.3.rationale: Climate stress test using NGFS phase 4 Delayed Transition (~1.6C by 2100, i.e. below 2C) and an in-house short-term Sudden Wake-Up Call scenario; NPL results 4-8%; pilot physical risk stress test; resilience conclusion in sec 3.4.

R.1.label: Disclosed
R.1.rationale: Climate risk treated as cross-cutting driver of credit/market/operational/reputational risk (Table 3); project-, PFI- and sovereign-level screening and assessment procedures for transition and physical risk (sec 4.4).

R.2.label: Disclosed
R.2.rationale: Responses per risk type in Table 3; climate risk in Risk Appetite Statement reviewed by Audit and Risk Committee; monitoring of climate-related financial risks (sec 4.5) and inclusion in internal risk ratings (sec 4.6).

R.3.label: Disclosed
R.3.rationale: Section 4.1 explicitly describes integration of climate risk into the existing risk management framework (second line of defence, risk taxonomy, Risk Appetite Statement).

M.1.label: Disclosed
M.1.rationale: Metrics overview (Table 6): own carbon footprint, financed emissions, portfolio heatmap, deep-dive transition/physical risk of portfolio, fossil-fuel exposure, physical risk to offices, green project reporting.

M.2.label: Disclosed
M.2.rationale: Scope 1, 2 (location- and market-based) and Scope 3 per GHG Protocol, plus separately disclosed financed emissions (Scope 3 cat. 15) for part of the portfolio.

M.3.label: Disclosed
M.3.rationale: Targets with time frames and progress: green finance >=50% of annual investment by 2025 (50% in 2023); 25-40 MtCO2e/yr net reductions 2021-25 (28.4 Mt achieved); carbon-neutral own operations since 2017; Paris alignment from 2023. Long-term own-GHG targets still to be set.
